\viewkind4\uc1\pard\qc\cf1\fs40 Pokebreed\cf2\ul\fs24 
\par \pard\cf1 Intro:\ulnone 
\par This is a game of breeding pokemon and evolving them. There is a gym where you get pokemon for the gym leaders. You can also buy or sell pokemon.
\par 
\par \ul How to play:\ulnone 
\par When the game starts, the will be 2 \i Charmanders\i0 , 2 \i Squirtles\i0 , and 2 \i Bulbasaurs \i0 in pens. Left click a gate to open or close it. Drag a pokemon to where ever you want. Bring 2 pokemon of different gender to the breeding area (corner pens) and they will breed. 2 of the same specie make a baby, while mixed species make different pokemon. Most pokemon will evolve over time, but some need stones to evolve. Eggs have a 50:50 chance of male or female. You can press enter to open the shop and buy more pokemon.
\par 
\par \ul Controls:\ulnone 
\par \b Left Mouse\b0  = Used to drag pokemon to where ever you want.
\par \b Middle Mouse/Space Bar (when pokemon is selected)\b0  = Pokemon's Ability (make flowers, fire, ect.)
\par \b Right Mouse\b0  = Send Pokemon to Middle/ Sell Item
\par \b Arrow Keys\b0 /\b A,S,D,W \b0 = Move View Area
\par \b Enter/E\b0  = Enter Shop
\par \b Esc\b0  = Exit Game
\par 
\par \b Page Up/Down\b0  = Speed Up/Down
\par \b End/R\b0  = Go to middle area
\par \b T\b0  = Toggle Terrain Edit Mode
\par \b F1\b0  = See this info
\par \b F2 \b0 = Restart
\par \b F4\b0  = Switch to fullscreen
\par \b F5\b0  = Save (also in shop)
\par \b F6\b0  = Load (also in shop)
\par \b F12 \b0 = Enter Cheat
\par \b Print Screen\b0  = Save screenshot to clipboard
\par 
\par \ul Notes:\ulnone 
\par *Some Pokemon have no gender. They count as ether gender for breeding.
\par *Some pokemon are too big to fit in the center area. If you right click them, they will do nothing.
\par *Pokemon can get stuck in fences. If this happens, just pull them off.
\par *You can move terrain in terrain editing mode. Turn terrain editing mode on or off in the shop or with T.
\par
